title: PaperFormalizer：作者参与式研究论文 Lean 自动形式化
summary: PaperFormalizer 是一个基于 Lean 的智能体流水线，从 LaTeX 源码出发，将论文转写为陈述依赖图，审计每条陈述的忠实性、歧义与正确性，并在 Lean 中对照 Mathlib 完成形式化与证明。流水线在陈述存在多种解读时暂停并询问作者，所有修复以提案形式呈现，由作者决定是否接受，最终产出经修订标注的论文、变更报告及与陈述关联的 Lean 代码。
summary_en: PaperFormalizer is a Lean-based agentic pipeline that turns a paper's LaTeX source into a dependency graph of statements, audits each for faithfulness, ambiguity and correctness, then formalizes and proves them in Lean against Mathlib. It pauses to consult the author whenever a statement admits multiple readings, presenting every repair as a proposal the author can accept, decline or redirect. Outputs include an annotated revised paper, a change report, and Lean code linked to each statement.
